news.headline: America Has a New National Park in Arizona
news.body: Chiricahua National Monument in southeastern Arizona is now a national park! A new law on October 20 upgraded it. A giant volcano erupted there 27 million years ago, and the ash hardened into rock. Over time, wind and water carved the rock into tall pillars called hoodoos. Visitors can hike among them and might spot bears, birds, and mountain lions. The land is also the homeland of the Chiricahua Apache.

news.headline: Did Van Gogh Paint a Real Night Sky?
news.body: Astronomers have traced Vincent van Gogh's famous painting The Starry Night to a real night sky. A new study says it shows the sky as it looked on July 22, 1889. The scientists matched clues in the painting to what was really shining overhead that night. It is a fun mix of art and astronomy!

word_of_the_day.sentence: Erosion carved the tall rock pillars over millions of years.

this_day_in_history: On November 17, 1869, the Suez Canal opened in Egypt, giving ships a shortcut from the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea. 🚢
did_you_know: Hoodoos are tall, skinny rock towers that form when harder rock on top protects the softer rock below from wearing away. 🪨
